# CANDIDATE: VWAP_RIBBON_RSI_PULLBACK_LONG

**Filed:** 2026-08-24  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Price pulling back to VWAP during a bullish EMA ribbon alignment with mild RSI oversold often bounces due to institutional support. This setup adds ribbon alignment, RSI pullback filter (30‑40), and an opening‑range‑high condition to the basic VWAP reclaim to reduce false breakouts and capture higher‑probability intraday reversals.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Go long when all of the following occur on the same bar:
- Price closes above VWAP after two consecutive closes below VWAP (i.e., a VWAP reclamation).
- The 8/21/34 EMA ribbon is bullish (8‑EMA > 21‑EMA > 34‑EMA).
- RSI(14) is between 30 and 40 (mild oversold).
- The prior bar closed above the opening range high (ORH) – ensures momentum into the reclamation bar.
**Exit:** Initial stop is a chart‑stop at the most recent swing low (invalidates higher‑high/higher‑low structure). Take profit at 1.5× risk or trail 12% off the highest‑watermark close. Time‑based exit at 15:50 ET if neither stop nor target hit.
